info.name: dart
info.category: AOT native (dart compile exe) or JIT VM — tracing GC
info.typing: Statically and soundly typed; sound null safety
info.runtime: Dart VM (JIT) for development; AOT native executable for production
info.design_notes: Dart runs two ways from one toolchain. `dart run` executes on a JIT VM with fast startup; `dart compile exe` builds an ahead-of-time native executable with no VM warmup. Both use a generational tracing garbage collector. Small integers box on the VM, so arithmetic-heavy loops trail the native and JVM languages, but AOT startup is instant and the memory profile is moderate.
key_traits: One toolchain, two runtimes: JIT VM and AOT native
Generational tracing GC — brief pauses under allocation churn
Between Go and the JVM on arithmetic-heavy loops
info.peak_speed: AOT within ~1.5–3× of C++ on arithmetic
